title: Promoter DNA Methylation and Promoter Chromatin Accessibility as Explanations of Gene Expression in Primary Tumors: Breast Discovery Analysis and Pre-Specified Pan-Cancer Test in TCGA (code, analysis plans and results)
description: Analysis code, two internal analysis plans with SHA-256 hashes, timed deviations logs, numerical results, figures and manuscript build code for a secondary, observational multi-omic analysis of TCGA primary tumors with matched ATAC-seq, DNA methylation and RNA-seq. Breast discovery analysis: 73 tumors, plan committed 2026-11-16 (SHA-256 b2b7079a364df1e80b5e9c5c0c46947204045ea7e401b5e1b1391ce3e8b48d2d). Pan-cancer test (added in 2.0.0): nine further cancer types, 191 tumors, plan committed 2026-11-25T00:03:36Z before any non-breast data were read (SHA-256 c440f092afb11f7e4afb9a7204ef51550ff12d0d88ad6f5c765527fbd542fa3b); two of three pre-specified criteria were met and one (consistency across types) was not. Version 2.0.0 also replaces the RNA-seq download address, which now returns HTTP 403, with one that serves byte-identical files. All input data are public and are downloaded by the included scripts; raw data are not redistributed.
